text: What happens inside me during a period?

steps.title: Hormones drop
steps.say: As an example, I set day 3 of a typical cycle. Estrogen and progesterone have fallen, and that drop is the signal for the lining to let go.

steps.title: The lining sheds
steps.say: The thick lining built last month comes away and leaves as your period, helped by the uterus gently contracting, which you may feel as cramps.

steps.title: A new egg gets going
steps.say: Meanwhile the ovary starts growing a new follicle, so the lining starts rebuilding and the cycle begins again.

lines.text: Hormones fall, the lining built last month comes away, and that is your period.
You may feel cramps as the uterus contracts to push the lining out.
The ovary is already growing a new egg follicle. This is a typical day 3.
